title: The VIX Is Starting To Tell A Different Story
speaker: Anthony and Shawn (Geeks of Finance)

macro_themes.view: The AI infrastructure trade did not fall apart after Micron earnings, a good sign into the next earnings cycle.
SPX pinned around the 7,700 gamma strike; above it is bullish territory.

calls.condition: Breakout above 7,700 is bullish; below it bears in control
calls.reason: Channel of lower highs/lows for weeks; largest gamma at 7,700 and heavy bullish flows (+$135M, $40M+ at 7,700) despite trading below it.
calls.quote: in our view, we're looking for a breakout above the 7,700 level.

calls.reason: IWM at the low end of its range with largest gamma at 280 and positive flows; rolled short 285 puts expecting mean reversion to 285.
calls.quote: We think, again, a mean reversion move potentially up to that 285 level could be in the works here.

calls.condition: Holding above 17 opens a squeeze to 20+; losing 16 opens 15
calls.reason: Long upper wick rejected at 17.59 and closed below 17; negative GEX, 1-hour Keltner channel and trendline make 15 a floor.
calls.quote: if it's able to hold above 17, that that opens the door to a bit of a squeeze, if you will, up to this 20 …

calls.reason: Consolidating under 400 (largest gamma) with stacked rising 10/20/50 MAs and gamma building up to 450 for Oct 16 OPEX; holds a 400/425 call debit spread.
calls.quote: we think somewhere in this zone over the course of the next couple of weeks could be a potential target.

calls.reason: Strongly positive net GEX up to 360, held 15 EMA and weekly HMA; holds a 325/320 put credit spread; rotates into Mag 7 on weak days.
calls.quote: combined with the GEX picture, we think the odds favor higher prices.

calls.reason: Rallied 2.69% after earnings; big gamma at 1,100 growing up to 1,300 and MAs pointing up; holds 1050/1040 put credit spread (Oct 16).
calls.quote: still has some potential bullish momentum to the upside.

calls.reason: Rising channel of higher lows since late July, stacked rising MAs, largest positive GEX at 300 and positive flows.
calls.quote: This also looks poised for higher prices following Micron earnings

notes: Date: 'Micron reporting earnings last night' (Micron reported Wed 9/30 after close per xjZq2CNL8Qg) -> Thu 2026-10-01; listing said 10-02. Note Meet Kevin's Oct 1 stream showed MU down ~3% intraday, so the +2.69% close is a reversal or a date mismatch. PANW target given as the 400-450 zone; 450 recorded.
